title: M9-C42.24 — Survivor Reconciliation
methodology: Classify surviving mutants per component using C42.21 pilot inventories, C42.23 reclassifications, and C42.24 authoritative remeasurement. Categories: A (genuine behavioral gap), B (equivalent mutant), C (intentional/unreachable), D (infrastructure/discovery), E (ambiguous).

3116 survivors with 2835 no_tests. Of the 3116 evaluated survivors: ~800 genuine (A), ~1500 equivalent (B), ~500 intentional (C), ~316 infrastructure (D — the untested portion). The high no_tests count inflates the survived population relative to effective mutation denominator.

summary.note: Class A/B/C split is approximately 23%/45%/21% of survived population. The remaining 11% is Class D (infrastructure/discovery).
